name: Virgental & Umbalfälle
kurzbeschreibung: The sun-kissed Virgental valley in East Tyrol is a pristine alpine valley in the Hohe Tauern National Park, home to the thunderous Umbal Waterfalls.
preis: Valley freely accessible; Umbal Waterfalls trail free (Ströden car park fee applies)
oeffnungszeiten: Accessible year-round; hiking season early June to mid-October
beschreibung:
Overview

The wildly romantic Virgental in East Tyrol is one of the most unspoiled and scenery-rich high-alpine valleys in the Eastern Alps. Flanked by the glaciated three-thousand-meter giants of the Venediger and Lasörling ranges, this sun-drenched valley stretches from Matrei in Osttirol through the picturesque national park villages of Virgen and Prägraten to the majestic head of the valley at the foot of the Großvenediger (3,657 m). Defined by traditional mountain farming, sun-blackened timber farmsteads, and sustainable tourism, the valley is a textbook example of gentle alpine recreation. Nestled in the heart of the Hohe Tauern National Park, the Virgental captivates nature lovers with roaring glacial torrents, larch meadows, and the raw kinetic force of the Umbal Waterfalls, Europe's first water-themed educational trail.

Route & Requirements

The Virgental offers hiking opportunities for every fitness level and age. Casual walkers and families appreciate the sunny, easy valley trail in Virgen or the stroller-accessible path to the Umbal Waterfalls starting from the Ströden car park (approx. 1 hour, easy). Along the waterfall trail, cantilevered steel platforms project dramatically over the cascading waters of the River Isel, the last free-flowing glacial river in the Alps. For seasoned mountaineers, the valley is the gateway to legendary high routes such as the Venediger High Trail or the Lasörling Trail from hut to hut. Demanding high-alpine tours require sturdy hiking boots, weatherproof gear, surefootedness, and solid stamina; comfortable walking shoes are sufficient along the valley floor. Sunny wooden loungers invite you to rest beside the sparkling streams.

Visit & Arrival

The Virgental is a rewarding year-round destination. The primary hiking season extends from early June to mid-October, while winter brings dependable cross-country skiing and ski touring. Arrive by car via Lienz or through the Felbertauern Tunnel to Matrei in Osttirol, then follow the well-surfaced Virgentalstraße (L24) to Virgen and Prägraten. Regular VVT regional buses serve the valley and are free for overnight guests holding a guest card. A large paid car park is located at the valley head in Ströden.

Tips

Hike the Umbal Waterfalls trail to experience the thundering spray from the viewing platforms. Afterwards, stop at the historic Islitzer Alm or Pebellalm to savour authentic East Tyrolean Schlipfkrapfen ravioli and fluffy Kaiserschmarrn while gazing out at the glaciated peaks of the Venediger range.
saison: Mai bis Oktober (Wasserschaupfad im Winter schneebedeckt)
